web.title: LinkedIn Scraper API - Bright Data Docs
web.description:
## [​](https://docs.brightdata.com/datasets/scrapers/linkedin/introduction#how-it-works)  How it works
```
Your app  -->  Bright Data API  -->  Structured JSON
           POST /datasets/v3/scrape
           Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

## [​](https://docs.brightdata.com/datasets/scrapers/linkedin/introduction#what-the-response-looks-like)  What the response looks like
```
curl -X POST "https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/scrape?dataset_id=gd_l1viktl72bvl7bjuj0&format=json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '[{"url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/satyanadella"}]'
```

```
{
  "name": "Satya Nadella",
  "city": "Redmond",
  "country_code": "US",
  "current_company": { "name": "Microsoft" },
  "followers": 10842560,
  "about": "Chairman and CEO at Microsoft..."
}
```

web.title: Discover Posts by Profile URL
web.description:
## Documentation Index
Discover Posts by Profile URL

```
curl --request POST \
  --url https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/scrape \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '
{
  "input": [\
    {\
      "url": "<string>"\
    }\
  ]
}
'
```

```
require 'uri'
require 'net/http'

url = URI("https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/scrape")

http = Net::HTTP.new(url.host, url.port)
http.use_ssl = true

request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(url)
request["Authorization"] = 'Bearer <token>'
request["Content-Type"] = 'application/json'
request.body = "{\n  \"input\": [\n    {\n      \"url\": \"<string>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"

response = http.request(request)
puts response.read_body
```

web.title: Discover LinkedIn posts by profile URL
web.description:
## Documentation Index
Discover LinkedIn Posts by Profile URL

```
const options = {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {Authorization: 'Bearer <token>', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
  body: JSON.stringify({
    input: [\
      {\
        url: '<string>',\
        start_date: '<string>',\
        end_date: '<string>',\
        only_authored_posts: true\
      }\
    ]
  })
};

fetch('https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/scrape', options)
  .then(res => res.json())
  .then(res => console.log(res))
  .catch(err => console.error(err));
```

```
require 'uri'
require 'net/http'

url = URI("https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/scrape")

http = Net::HTTP.new(url.host, url.port)
http.use_ssl = true

request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(url)
request["Authorization"] = 'Bearer <token>'
request["Content-Type"] = 'application/json'
request.body = "{\n  \"input\": [\n    {\n      \"url\": \"<string>\",\n      \"start_date\": \"<string>\",\n      \"end_date\": \"<string>\",\n      \"only_authored_posts\": true\n    }\n  ]\n}"

response = http.request(request)
puts response.read_body
```
